entries.message: This update includes stage tautulli backup and import flow, refresh detail after watch date removal, show affected media sync state, keep multi-item sync updates responsive, and keep queued media changes visible.
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Tautulli imports now separate preview review, the recommended local backup, and the final import with clear progress and syncing completion states.
Removing one watch date now refreshes the open detail from authoritative history while preserving any surviving watch.
Surface live syncing notices on affected movie and show detail pages.
Pause only the visible item's watch controls until import or dispatch completes.
Document and test the targeted sync-state behavior.
Index visible episodes and cache season state during live progress updates.
Prevent repeated bulk watch actions from stalling the detail page before the sync notice paints.
Treat pending dispatch telemetry as active detail sync even between progress heartbeats.
Animate Up Next add and remove requests while preserving labels on failure.
Extend the sync-state regression coverage for queued work.
messageFragments: Fix - Stage tautulli backup and import flow
Fix - Refresh detail after watch date removal
Fix - Show affected media sync state
Fix - Keep multi-item sync updates responsive
Fix - Keep queued media changes visible
